name: Ford - Cleveland Engine Plant, Brook Park OH

fieldNotes.site: Ford Cleveland Engine Plant (No. 1), Brook Park OH - active engine plant producing 2.0/2.3L EcoBoost I4 and 3.5L EcoBoost V6 engines, ~2,055 employees, 1.6M sq ft. Roster geocode (41.4167,-81.8220) lands directly on the large multi-roof plant building - confirmed correct. Former Cleveland Engine Plant No. 2 immediately to the SW has been demolished (cleared land visible; the former plant parcel sold for $31.5M).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence encircles the property; Street View (2016 & 2025) shows the fenced property line with gated entry points. The plant's south-side truck/drop yard connects to the public road via a controlled driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Marked true at medium confidence - a fenced, ~2,000-employee active Ford engine plant of this scale conventionally operates a staffed gatehouse, and the perimeter is clearly secured. A guard-booth structure could not be positively resolved in available imagery (some panos are 2016); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: South-side truck yard holds an estimated 15-20 parked trailers in rows against a paved apron (z19/z20 imagery); banded 10-25. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 10-25 dock doors along the south building face serving the truck yard; exact count obscured by roof angle - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run NW-SE directly alongside the plant's NW face - clearly rail-served.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The south truck yard apron is wide with substantial unused paved width; physical room exists for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: buildingCount 2 reflects the main plant plus a detached NW office building; the adjacent former Plant No. 2 is demolished. multipleFacilities marked false (single active plant cluster); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Brook Park is a dense industrial suburb within the Cleveland metro, hemmed by I-71/I-480 interchanges and continuous industrial development - Urban.
